arg.name: robot_model
arg.description: FANUC CRX model.

arg.name: robot_ip
arg.description: The robot's IP address.

arg.name: planner
arg.description: Benchmark back-end: ompl | pilz_lin | mtc.

arg.name: planning_pipeline
arg.description: move_group pipeline. Use pilz_industrial_motion_planner for planner:=pilz_lin.

arg.name: joint_limits_file
arg.description: Joint limits YAML. Use config/pilz_joint_limits.yaml for planner:=pilz_lin.

arg.name: planner_id
arg.description: Optional planner id override (Pilz defaults to LIN).

arg.name: group
arg.description: Planning group.

arg.name: mtc_solver
arg.description: MTC solver: pipeline | interpolation.

arg.name: mtc_pipeline
arg.description: Underlying pipeline for the MTC pipeline solver.

arg.name: iterations
arg.description: Number of forward+reverse MOTR repetitions.

arg.name: velocity_scaling
arg.description: Max velocity scaling factor (0-1).

arg.name: acceleration_scaling
arg.description: Max acceleration scaling factor (0-1).

arg.name: planning_time
arg.description: Planning time budget per request (s).

arg.name: planning_attempts
arg.description: Planning attempts per request.

arg.name: state_wait_timeout
arg.description: Abort if the current robot state is not obtained within this many seconds.

arg.name: motr_max_retries
arg.description: Retry an STMO-aborted MOTR this many times after motion_possible is restored. 0 disables retry.

arg.name: motr_retry_motion_timeout
arg.description: Per retry, wait at most this many seconds for motion_possible to be restored before giving up.

arg.name: motr_retry_stable_s
arg.description: motion_possible must stay true continuously for this many seconds before a retry is attempted.

arg.name: poses_file
arg.description: Waypoint definition file.

arg.name: launch_moveit
arg.description: Also bring up move_group + the FANUC driver.

arg.name: launch_rviz
arg.description: Launch RViz with move_group and show RViz startup messages on the terminal.

arg.name: rviz_output
arg.description: RViz logging destination: log (file only), screen (console only), or both. Defaults to screen so RViz startup issues are visible immediately.

arg.name: record_bag
arg.description: Record a rosbag of the run.

arg.name: analyze
arg.description: After the run, automatically run analyze_benchmark.py and print the per-MOTR results/stats to the terminal.

arg.name: stmo_recovery
arg.description: Watch for STMO inactive warnings and issue the recovery service call.

arg.name: output_dir
arg.description: Directory for the recorded bag.

arg.name: timestamp
arg.description: Evaluated once; used as the bag name suffix (benchmark_%TIMESTAMP%).
